'''Pacôme Djenon Dadiet''' (born 27 July 2005) is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[New York Knicks]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA). He previously played for [[Paris Basketball]] and [[Ratiopharm Ulm]].

==Early life and career==
Dadiet was born on 27 July 2005 and is of [[Ivory Coast|Ivorian]] descent.<ref name="auto3">{{cite web|title=Pacome Dadiet|url=https://www.proballers.com/basketball/player/242349/pacome-dadiet|website=Proballers.com|access-date=30 November 2024}}</ref><ref name="auto1">{{cite web|title=Pacome Dadiet|url=https://www.fiba.basketball/fr/player/298550/Pacome--Dadiet|website=FIBA.basketball|publisher=[[FIBA]]|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref> As a youth, he joined the club {{ill|Saint-Charles Charenton|fr|Saint-Charles Charenton Saint-Maurice Basket-ball}} in 2011, where he remained through 2020 and was teammates with players such as [[Tidjane Salaün]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Tests d'entrée à l'INSEP : 3 joueurs de la Saint Charles|trans-title=INSEP entry tests: 3 players from Saint Charles|url=https://www.saintcharlesbasket.fr/articles/50356-tests-d-entree-a-l-insep-3-joueurs-de-la-saint-charles|publisher={{ill|Saint-Charles Charenton|fr|Saint-Charles Charenton Saint-Maurice Basket-ball}}|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref> He then spent time with the youth team of [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]], before joining the youth program of [[Paris Basketball]].<ref>{{cite news|last=Pratdessus|first=Valérie|title=Le risque calculé de Pacôme Dadiet qui a choisi Ulm, en Allemagne|trans-title=The calculated risk of Pacôme Dadiet who chose Ulm, Germany|url=https://www.lequotidiendusport.fr/le-crisque-calcule-de-pacome-dadiet-qui-a-choisi-ulm-en-allemagne/|newspaper=[[Le Quotidien du Sport]]|date=16 February 2024|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref> He appeared in 22 matches for the club's Under-21 team in the 2021–22 season, averaging 17.3 points, 5.2 rebounds and 1.7 assists per game.<ref name="auto">{{cite magazine|first=Florian|last=Kurth|title=Ulm bring another top European talent to the squad|url=https://basketnews.com/news-176627-ulm-bring-another-top-european-talent-to-the-squad.html|magazine=[[Basket News]]|date=18 August 2022|access-date=30 November 2024}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===Paris Basketball (2021–2022)===
Dadiet made his [[LNB Pro A]] debut for Paris Basketball's first team in October 2021, at the age of 16, totaling seven points in eight minutes of playing time.<ref name="auto2">{{cite web|title=7 points en 8 minutes : les débuts réussis de Pacôme Dadiet (16 ans) au niveau professionnel|trans-title=7 points in 8 minutes: the successful debut of Pacôme Dadiet (16 years old) at the professional level|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/7-points-en-8-minutes-les-debuts-reussis-de-pacome-dadiet-16-ans-au-niveau-professionnel|website=BeBasket.fr|date=21 October 2021|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref> He featured in eight games throughout the 2021–22 season for the main squad.<ref name="auto3" />

===Ratiopharm Ulm (2023–2024)===
Dadiet sought to leave Paris and join German club [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] in 2022,<ref>{{cite web|first=Alexandre|last=Lacoste|title=Mais où est passé Pacôme Dadiet?|trans-title=But where did Pacôme Dadiet go?|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/mais-ou-est-passe-pacome-dadiet |website=BeBasket.fr|date=26 October 2022|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref> but was involved in a contractual dispute which did not allow him to join them until January 2023.<ref>{{cite news|title=Pacôme Dadiet officiellement joueur du Ratiopharm Ulm|trans-title=Pacôme Dadiet officially a Ratiopharm Ulm player|url=https://tribune47.com/pacome-dadiet-officiellement-joueur-du-ratiopharm-ulm/|newspaper=[[Tribune 47]]|date=16 January 2023|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|first=Alexandre|last=Lacoste|title=De Paris à Ulm, Pacôme Dadiet (enfin) libéré|trans-title=From Paris to Ulm, Pacôme Dadiet (finally) released|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/de-paris-a-ulm-pacome-dadiet-enfin-libere|language=French|website=BeBasket.fr|date=13 January 2023|access-date=30 November 2024}}</ref> During the 2022–23 season, he played for Ulm's developmental team, [[OrangeAcademy]], in the German third tier, averaging 16 points and 4.2 rebounds per game.<ref name="auto3" /> He also featured in one game for the first team, playing three minutes.<ref>{{cite web|title=Pacome Dadiet International Stats|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/international/players/pacome-dadiet-1.html|website=Basketball-Reference.com|access-date=30 November 2024}}</ref>

He became a regular starter for Ulm's senior side during the [[2023–24 Basketball Bundesliga|2023–24 season]], and was viewed as a potential [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] prospect.<ref name="auto3" /><ref>{{cite magazine|title=NBA Draft Scouting Report: France's Pacome Dadiet|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/prospect-profiles/nba-draft-scouting-report-frances-pacome-dadiet|magazine=[[Sports Illustrated]]|date=1 January 2024|access-date=30 November 2024}}</ref>

===New York / Westchester Knicks (2024–present)===
On 2 May 2024, the NBA confirmed that Dadiet was one of the international players who had declared for the [[2024 NBA draft]].<ref>{{cite web|title=NBA announces early entry candidates for NBA Draft 2024|url=https://www.nba.com/news/nba-draft-2024-early-entry-candidates|website=NBA.com|date=2 May 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref>

On 26 June 2024, Dadiet was selected with the 25th overall pick by the [[New York Knicks]] in the 2024 NBA draft.<ref>{{cite web|first=Sam|last=Quinn|title=2024 NBA Draft: Knicks take Pacome Dadiet at No. 25 overall with an eye toward the roster's future|url=https://www.cbssports.com/nba/news/2024-nba-draft-knicks-take-pacome-dadiet-at-no-25-overall-with-an-eye-toward-the-rosters-future/|work=[[CBS Sports]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{cite web|first=Tim|last=Bontemps|title=Hawks use No. 1 pick on France's Risacher, 19|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/40440314/hawks-pick-france-zaccharie-risacher-no-1-nba-draft|work=[[ESPN]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{cite web|title=NBA-Draft: Pacome Dadiet: Von ratiopharm Ulm zu den New York Knicks|url=https://www.sportschau.de/regional/swr/swr-pacome-dadiet-von-ratiopharm-ulm-zu-den-new-york-knicks-100.html|website=Sportschau.de |publisher=[[Sportschau]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024|language=de-DE}}</ref> He was one of the four French players drafted during the first round, following [[Zaccharie Risacher]], [[Alex Sarr|Alexandre Sarr]] and [[Tidjane Salaün]].<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web|first=Gaëtan|last=Delafolie|title=Risacher et Sarr au sommet, Salaün dans le top 10 : draft NBA historique pour la France|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Risacher-n-1-sarr-n-2-draft-nba-historique-pour-la-france/1477805|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=27 June 2024|access-date=27 June 2024|language=fr-FR}}</ref> On 5 July, he signed with the Knicks.<ref>{{cite web|title=Pacôme Dadiet Signed by Knicks|url=https://www.nba.com/knicks/news/pacome-dadiet-signed-by-knicks|website=NBA.com|date=5 July 2024|access-date=5 July 2024}}</ref>

Dadiet made his NBA debut on October 22, 2024, in a 132–109 loss to the [[Boston Celtics]], scoring 3 points.<ref>{{cite web|title=New York Knicks at Boston Celtics Box Score, October 22, 2024|url=https://www.basketball-reference.com/boxscores/202410220BOS.html|website=Basketball-Reference.com|date=October 26, 2024|access-date=October 26, 2024}}</ref> Throughout his rookie season, he has been [[NBA G League#Standard assignment|assigned]] several times to the [[Westchester Knicks]].<ref>{{cite web|title=2024-2025 Westchester Knicks Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/gleague/teams/Westchester-Knicks/40/Transaction_History/2025|website=RealGM.com|access-date=17 December 2024}}</ref>

On 13 June 2026, Dadiet and the Knicks won the [[2026 NBA Finals]], beating the [[San Antonio Spurs]] 4–1.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/news/live-updates-2026-nba-finals-game-5-knicks-seek-first-title-since-1973|title=Recap: The Knicks win the 2026 NBA championship|website=[[NBA.com]]|last=Lambert|first=Ben|date=June 13, 2026|access-date=June 13, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/nba/new-york-knicks/knicks-news-first-championship-53-years-nba-finals-spurs|title=Knicks win first championship in 53 years after NBA Finals Game 5 triumph vs. Spurs|website=[[ClutchPoints]]|last=Siegel|first=Brett|date=June 13, 2026|access-date=June 13, 2026}}</ref>

==National team career==
Dadiet represented France at the [[2021 FIBA U16 European Challengers]], where he played five games and averaged six points and 1.4 rebounds.<ref name="auto1"/> He later participated at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]] and helped France win the bronze medal while averaging 4.3 points, 2.2 assists and 1.4 rebounds per game.<ref name="auto"/>

==Personal life==
Dadiet's older brother, Maxence, is also a basketball player, who represents the [[Ivory Coast men's national basketball team|Ivory Coast national team]] at international level.<ref name="auto2"/><ref>{{cite web|first=Gabriel|last=Pantel-Jouve|title=Le retour fracassant de Pacôme Dadiet|trans-title=The shattering return of Pacôme Dadiet|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/le-retour-fracassant-de-pacome-dadiet|website=BeBasket.fr|date=9 July 2022|access-date=30 November 2024|language=French}}</ref>
